title: Change an organisation's name, address or contact details with Transport for NSW
summary: This page explains how to update an organisation's name, address, phone number, or email address with Transport for NSW.
intro: If an organisation’s name, address, phone number or email address has changed, the details will need to be updated on the relevant:
who_can_apply: An organisation whose name, address, phone number, or email address has changed.
what_you_need: Proof of identity, such as a driver licence.
A letter on the organisation's letterhead, signed by a director, secretary, president, or chairperson, that authorizes you as the organisation's representative.
If changing the organisation’s name, a Certificate of Registration on Change of Name from the Australian Securities and Investments Commission (ASIC).

One of the following PDF forms: Change of Records – Maritime Products Only (https://tfnswforms.transport.nsw.gov.au/45071760-adjustment-to-records-maritime.pdf) or Change of Records – Road and Maritime Products (https://tfnswforms.transport.nsw.gov.au/45070212-change-of-records.pdf).

how_to_steps.text: Download and complete the relevant PDF form:
Submit your documents at a Service NSW Centre.

faqs.q: What details can I update for my organisation?
faqs.a: You can update your organisation's name, address, phone number, or email address.

faqs.q: Where do I submit the updated details?
faqs.a: You must submit your documents at a Service NSW Centre.

faqs.q: What documents do I need if I am changing the organisation's name?
faqs.a: If changing the organisation’s name, you need a Certificate of Registration on Change of Name from the Australian Securities and Investments Commission (ASIC).
